Cindrel.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single young bird stands centred in the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on a patch of dusty ochre ground scattered with a few glowing cinders, with a soft brown shadow beneath it. Warm key light comes from the upper left and lays a pale highlight on its head and back, with a thin orange rim light on its right edge. The creature is a plump, fluffy fledgling shaped like a young hoopoe, with soft charcoal-grey down, a cream-buff face and chest, a short, slightly curved dark beak and bright amber eyes. A small fan-shaped crest of stubby feathers rises from its head, each feather tipped with glowing ember orange like the end of a burning stick. Its short rounded wings are barred with black and cream stripes, and their tips smoulder with a faint orange glow. It stands on two thin grey legs with small dark claws. A few tiny sparks float up from its crest. In the background, a loose wash of warm amber fading into ember orange, only soft blotches of pigment with a lighter haze behind the bird.

Flarrow.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single bird strides forward across the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, wings half raised, on dry ochre ground with a soft shadow beneath it. Warm key light from the upper left highlights its crest and shoulders, with a hot orange rim light along its back. The creature is a slender, long-legged young bird shaped like a hoopoe grown lean and fast, with smooth charcoal-grey plumage, a cream-buff breast, a long, thin, curved dark beak and bright amber eyes. A tall fan crest of long feathers sweeps back from its head like a sheaf of arrows, each feather tipped with bright flickering flame orange. Its pointed wings are boldly barred in black and cream with glowing ember edges, and a long narrow tail streams behind it. Its two thin grey legs end in dark claws. Shimmering heat haze ripples in the air around the tips of its crest. In the background, a wash of warm amber and ember orange with streaks of pale gold, lighter behind the bird.

Pyrequill.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single majestic bird stands tall in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, seen from a slightly low angle, its whole body from crest to feet filling most of the wide frame, wings spread wide, on scorched ochre ground scattered with glowing embers. Warm key light from the upper left gilds its crest and the tops of its wings, and a bright orange glow from its own feathers lights its underside. The creature is a large, regal, long-legged bird of prey built like a secretary bird, with sleek charcoal-grey plumage, a cream-buff chest, a strong hooked dark beak and fierce amber eyes. A magnificent crown of long black quill feathers fans out behind its head, every quill tipped with a burning ember that trails thin streams of sparks. Its broad wings are barred in black and cream with blazing flame-orange edges, and its long tail plumes glow like smouldering coals. Its long grey legs end in powerful dark talons. Small sparks rain softly around it. In the background, a rich wash of amber, ember orange and deep red, with bright gold light behind the crest.

Ashpaw.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single young creature crouches playfully in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, front paws spread low and hindquarters raised, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on a patch of grey ash-dusted ground with a soft shadow beneath it. Warm key light from the upper left lights its face and back, with a thin orange rim light along its tail. The creature is a stocky lynx kitten with soft, thick ash-grey fur flecked with faint charcoal spots, oversized paws that look dipped in soot, a very short stubby bobtail only as long as a paw with a black tip, a lean wild face with a naturalistic, not cartoonish, look, a pale cream muzzle and round bright amber eyes. Its pointed ears end in long black tufts that glow at the very tips like the ends of burning matches. A pale ruff of fluffy fur frames its cheeks. A few small sparks drift up from its paws. In the background, a loose wash of warm amber fading into ember orange, only soft blotches of pigment with a lighter haze behind the kitten.

Blazelynx.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature springs forward across the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, mid-stride with its front paws reaching, its full body filling most of the wide frame, over dusty ochre ground with a trail of glowing sparks behind it. Warm key light from the upper left lights its back and face, with a hot orange rim light along its legs. The creature is a lean, long-legged young lynx with a tawny-orange coat dappled with charcoal-grey spots, soot-dark paws, a short black-tipped tail, a cream muzzle and sharp amber eyes. Its pointed ears end in long black tufts that burn like small candle flames, and a fuller cheek ruff of pale fur flares around its face with glowing orange tips. Thin wisps of flame lick along the top of its shoulders. In the background, a wash of warm amber and ember orange with lighter diagonal streaks behind the lynx.

Solarlynx.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single majestic creature stands proudly on a low rocky outcrop in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, seen from a slightly low angle, its full body filling most of the wide frame. Warm golden light pours from the upper left, and a bright glow from its own ruff lights its face and chest. The creature is a large, powerful, mature lynx with a deep tawny-gold coat dappled with charcoal spots, soot-black paws, a short black-tipped tail and piercing amber eyes. A magnificent broad ruff of long fur radiates around its head and neck like the corona of the sun, shading from pale gold at the roots to blazing orange and red at the flaming tips. Its tall ears end in long black tufts crowned with bright flames. Soft shimmering rays of golden light fan out from behind its ruff. In the background, a brilliant wash of amber, gold and ember orange, glowing brightest behind its head like a sunrise.

Kilnback.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature stands centred in the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on a patch of dusty ochre ground with a soft brown shadow pooled beneath it. Warm key light comes from the upper left and lays a pale highlight along the top of its back, and a thin orange rim light traces its right edge. The creature is a stout, short-legged burrowing beast built like a badger crossed with an armadillo, with soot-grey leathery hide, small rounded ears, a blunt snout with a dark nose and ember-orange eyes. Its domed back is a shell of fired clay bricks in terracotta and rust tones, fitted in curved rows, with seams that glow bright orange as if lit from within. A short cylindrical clay chimney vent rises from the top of the shell and releases two thin curls of pale grey smoke that drift toward the upper right. Its four stubby legs end in thick dark claws pressed into the dust. In the background, a loose wash of warm amber fading into ember orange, only soft blotches of pigment with a lighter haze behind the creature.

Furnaceback.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single large creature stands in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, planted firmly on cracked, dusty ochre ground with a dark shadow pooled beneath it. Warm key light from the upper left lays a pale highlight along its back, and a bright orange glow from its shell lights the ground around it. The creature is a big, heavy, short-legged burrowing beast built like a giant badger crossed with an armadillo, with soot-grey leathery hide, small rounded ears, a broad blunt snout with a dark nose and glowing ember-orange eyes. Its high domed back is a massive shell of fired terracotta and rust-red bricks fitted in curved rows and bound with two dark iron bands, the seams glowing bright orange. Two short cylindrical clay chimneys rise from the top of the shell, each pouring a thick plume of grey smoke and a few sparks toward the upper right, and a small arched furnace opening on its flank glows with fire. Its four thick legs end in heavy dark claws. In the background, a loose wash of warm amber deepening into ember orange and rust, with a lighter haze behind the creature.

Waxwick.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small bird perches in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, on a short gnarled branch that crosses the lower part of the image. Warm key light from the upper left lights its crest and breast, and the small flame on its head casts a soft golden glow on its face. The creature is a plump little songbird shaped like a waxwing, with silky soft fawn-beige plumage, a black mask across its eyes, a small dark beak and a black chin. Its swept-back crest ends in a single slender wick-like feather topped by a tiny, steady candle flame. Its folded grey wings carry a few tiny glossy scarlet flecks at the feather tips, like a real waxwing, and its short tail ends in a band of yellow. A thin smooth ridge of hardened pale cream candle wax runs along the branch beneath its feet. In the background, a soft wash of warm amber and ember orange, lighter around the bird.

Cinderhorn.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature stands on a rocky slope in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, head lowered as if ready to charge, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on dark volcanic rock with a soft shadow beneath it. Warm key light from the upper left highlights its back and horns, with an orange glow from the horns on its face. The creature is a sturdy, muscular wild goat built like a mountain ibex, with a short, coarse charcoal-black coat, paler ash-grey legs and belly, a short dark beard and fierce amber eyes. Two massive ridged horns sweep back in long curves from its head; they are made of black volcanic rock cracked with bright glowing orange seams, like cooling lava. Thin wisps of smoke rise from the horn tips. Its four legs end in hard dark cloven hooves gripping the rock. In the background, a wash of warm amber and ember orange with darker smoky patches toward the upper corners.

Kilnfox.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature stands alert in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, one front paw raised, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on dusty ochre ground scattered with glowing embers. Warm key light from the upper left lights its face and back, and the glowing tip of its tail casts orange light on the ground behind it. The creature is a slender, elegant fox with a rich terracotta-red coat, soot-black legs and ear backs, a white throat and chest, a narrow muzzle and bright golden eyes. A line of small glazed clay tiles in burnt orange and cream runs along its spine from the neck to the base of its tail, their edges glowing faintly. Its long bushy tail ends in a tip that burns like a coal in a kiln, white-hot at the centre and orange at the edges, trailing a thin ribbon of sparks. In the background, a rich wash of amber, ember orange and deep rust, with bright gold light behind the fox.

Puddock.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small creature sits in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, on a flat mossy stone at the edge of a shallow puddle, with ripples spreading in the water around the stone. Soft warm key light from the upper left puts glossy highlights on its wet skin, with a cool blue rim light on its back. The creature is a plump young frog with smooth blue-green skin mottled with darker teal spots like river pebbles, a pale cream throat and belly, large round golden eyes with dark horizontal pupils and a wide closed mouth. Its back legs are folded beneath it, and its small front feet with round toe pads rest on the stone. A few clear bubbles float up from its mouth. In the background, a soft wash of pale teal and sea blue with lighter horizontal strokes.

Brookhorn.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature crouches on a rounded stone in the middle of a shallow, fast brook, in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, with white water swirling around the stone. Soft warm key light from the upper left gives glossy highlights on its wet skin, with a cool blue rim light along its back. The creature is a larger, sturdy, broad-headed frog with smooth blue-green skin mottled with darker teal river-pebble spots, a pale cream throat and large round golden eyes with dark horizontal pupils. Above each eye rises a pointed, curved horn-like ridge, and a low frilled crest like a translucent teal fin runs down the middle of its back. Its muscular hind legs are folded, ready to leap, and its webbed front feet grip the stone. A swirl of water curls around it. In the background, a wash of pale teal and sea blue with lighter diagonal streaks of flowing water.

Tidemaw.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single huge creature sits majestically on a broad wave-washed rock in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, seen from a slightly low angle, its full body filling most of the wide frame, with waves breaking white around the rock. Soft light comes from the upper left through a thin veil of falling rain, putting glossy highlights on its wet skin. The creature is a massive, ancient, toad-like frog with smooth blue-green skin mottled with darker teal river-pebble spots, a pale cream throat pouch and large golden eyes with dark horizontal pupils. Its enormous wide mouth is closed in a calm, powerful line. Curved horn-like ridges rise above its eyes, and a tall translucent teal fin crest runs from its head down its back. Its thick front legs end in broad webbed feet planted on the rock. A soft curtain of rain falls around it from a small grey rain cloud gathered above its head. In the background, a wash of deep teal, sea blue and storm grey, lighter behind the creature.

Rillet.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small fish swims in the centre of the frame in a side view facing frame-right, its whole body filling most of the wide frame, inside a loose, irregular patch of pale teal watercolour wash that suggests clear river water, with a few smooth pebbles and one strand of waterweed painted loosely below it. Soft warm light from the upper left lays rippling highlights on its back. The creature is a young, slender, ribbon-shaped fish with a shining silver-blue body, a row of small dark blue dots along its side, a rounded head with large dark eyes and a small mouth. A continuous ribbon-like dorsal fin in soft coral red runs along its whole back, starting as a short tuft above its head, and its body tapers to a thin pointed tail. A few small bubbles rise from its mouth. Around the wash, the bare textured white paper shows on every side of the frame.

Streamfin.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single long fish swims in a graceful S-shaped curve in the centre of the frame in a side view facing frame-left, its whole body filling most of the wide frame, inside a loose, irregular patch of pale teal and sea-blue watercolour wash with a few streaks of current, and a few pebbles painted loosely below it. Soft warm light from the upper left lays rippling highlights along its back. The creature is a sleek, elongated, ribbon-bodied fish with a shining silver-blue body, a row of small dark blue dots along its side, large dark eyes and a pointed snout. A tall, flowing coral-red dorsal fin runs the full length of its back, rising into a crest of several long streaming fin rays above its head, and two long trailing coral fins ripple beneath its chest. Small swirls of current and bubbles follow its tail. Around the wash, the bare textured white paper shows on every side of the frame.

Gulfwyrm.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single immense creature rises from a dark, rolling sea in great coils, in the centre of the frame and seen from a slightly low angle, its long body filling most of the wide frame, with white spray bursting around its coils. Cold silver light comes from the upper left and glints along its body. The creature is a majestic, serpent-long sea fish with a gleaming silver-blue body, a row of dark blue dots along its side, a long pointed head with calm, deep dark eyes and a closed mouth. A tall crest of long coral-red fin rays rises from its head and runs the full length of its back as a flowing ribbon fin, and every fin ray is rimed with white frost and tipped with small ice crystals. Thin plates of pale ice float on the water around it, and a few snowflakes drift in the air. In the background, a wash of deep sea blue, pale teal and frosty grey, lighter behind its head.

Kelpup.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature rests centred in the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the wide frame. It lies on a low, flat, wave-washed grey rock in the lower half of the frame, with shallow pale-teal water lapping around the rock and thin white foam lines at its edges. Soft warm key light comes from the upper left and puts glossy highlights on the wet head and back, with a gentle cool rim light along the far side. The creature is a chubby young harbour-seal-like pup with grey-blue fur dappled with darker slate spots, a round head, large dark wet eyes, a small dark nose and long pale whiskers. Several long ribbons of olive-green kelp drape over its shoulders and across its back and trail down over the rock into the water, with small round air bladders along the fronds. Its front flippers rest flat on the rock and its rear flippers curl up behind it. In the background, a soft wash of pale teal and sea blue with lighter horizontal strokes for a distant horizon.

Kelpwarden.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single large creature rests upright on a tall, wave-washed grey rock in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, head raised watchfully, with pale-teal waves and white foam breaking around the rock. Soft warm key light from the upper left puts glossy highlights on its wet head and shoulders, with a cool rim light along its back. The creature is a big, powerful adult seal with grey-blue fur dappled with darker slate spots, a broad head with large dark wet eyes, a dark nose and long pale whiskers. A heavy mantle of long olive-green kelp drapes over its shoulders and down its back like a cloak, with small round air bladders along the fronds, and strands of kelp wind around its front flippers and trail into the water. Its strong front flippers are braced on the rock. In the background, a soft wash of pale teal and sea blue with lighter horizontal strokes for a distant horizon.

Shellmote.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small creature floats just above calm shallow water in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the frame, with its soft reflection and small ripples below it. Soft warm key light from the upper left highlights its shell, with a cool rim light on the far side. The creature is a small hermit-crab-like animal living in a pale, pearly spiral sea shell striped with soft peach and cream bands. Its front half peeks out of the shell: two small rounded pale-coral claws, short jointed legs and two black bead eyes on short stalks. The shell is ringed by a cluster of clear, glistening bubbles that hold it aloft, and a few more bubbles drift upward. In the background, a soft wash of pale teal and sea blue with lighter horizontal strokes for a distant horizon.

Frosteel.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature lies coiled on a flat slab of pale blue ice at the edge of dark, cold water, in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its whole body filling most of the wide frame, head raised. Cold soft light comes from the upper left and makes its frosted fins sparkle, with a faint blue rim light on its back. The creature is a thick-bodied, wolf-eel-like fish with a long muscular body, a broad blunt head with a strong jaw, small pale eyes and pale ice-blue skin mottled with white frost patterns. A row of translucent icicle-like spines runs along its back, and its fins are fringed with fine white frost. A few ice crystals glitter in the air around it, and a thin rime of frost spreads across the ice beneath it. In the background, a wash of pale teal, ice blue and soft grey, lighter behind the creature.

Brinemoth.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single large moth hovers above a wave-washed shore in the centre of the frame, seen from the front at a slight angle, its wings spread wide and filling most of the wide frame, with a curling wave breaking below it. Soft warm light comes from the upper left and shines through its translucent wings. The creature is a large, graceful moth with a furry pale grey-blue body and two broad feathery antennae beaded with tiny drops of sea water. Its four wings are translucent teal shading to deep sea blue at the edges, patterned with flowing pale lines like the curl of waves, and crusted along the veins with sparkling white sea-salt crystals. Each hind wing ends in a long curling tail like a ribbon of sea foam. Fine salty spray and a few droplets drift around it. In the background, a rich wash of sea blue, pale teal and silver, with bright light behind its wings. The painting fades softly into the bare white paper near the edges of the frame, with irregular, uneven watercolour edges.

Sprigget.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single young creature stands in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, on a patch of short green grass and clover with a soft shadow beneath it. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its back, with a gentle rim light along its side. The creature is a small, long-legged fawn with a soft mossy-brown coat dappled with pale cream spots, large dark eyes, big soft ears and a black nose. From its forehead rise two short twig-like antler buds of green wood, each sprouting a few small fresh leaves. A patch of pale green lichen marks its shoulders. Its thin legs end in small dark hooves. A small leafy shoot curls from the ground beside its front hooves. In the background, a soft wash of sage and meadow green with pale cream patches.

Thornbuck.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature stands in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, head lowered slightly, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on a patch of meadow grass with a soft shadow beneath it. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its back and antlers, with a gentle rim light along its side. The creature is a lean young buck with a mossy-brown coat dappled with pale cream spots on its back, a pale belly, large dark eyes and a black nose. Its antlers are made of living bramble wood, brown and grey, branching into sharp curved thorns with small green leaves between them. Patches of pale green lichen cover its shoulders. Its long legs end in dark hooves. In the background, a soft wash of sage and meadow green with pale cream patches.

Elderhart.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single majestic creature stands in a forest glade in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, seen from a slightly low angle, its full body filling most of the wide frame, head held high. Soft warm light comes from the upper left through the trees and lays golden highlights on its antlers. The creature is a large, ancient stag with a thick mossy-brown coat, faint pale cream spots on its back, a long shaggy ruff of grey-green fur at its throat, calm dark eyes and a black nose. Its enormous antlers are like the branches of an old oak tree, gnarled brown wood hung with soft green moss and trailing ivy, sprouting fresh leaves and a few small white blossoms. Patches of pale lichen cover its shoulders. A few pale glowing seeds drift in the air around it. In the background, a rich wash of sage, moss and deep forest green, with warm light behind the stag.

Mirebud.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small creature sits at the edge of a boggy pool in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, among wet moss and small tufts of reeds. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its shell, with a gentle rim light along its side. The creature is a small bog turtle with a rounded dark olive-brown shell, wrinkled mossy-green skin with pale yellow spots, a small beaked face and bright orange eyes. A single closed bud of a pitcher plant, wine red and lime green, sprouts from the centre of its shell on a short stem, with a few small leaves around it. A faint puff of yellow-green spores drifts from the bud. In the background, a soft wash of sage and meadow green with murky olive patches.

Bogblossom.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature crawls through a misty bog in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on wet moss beside dark water. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its shell and flowers, with a gentle rim light along its side. The creature is a sturdy bog turtle with a high, ridged dark olive-brown shell, wrinkled mossy-green skin with pale yellow spots, a hooked beak and bright orange eyes. Its shell is covered in a small garden of carnivorous plants: several open wine-red and lime-green pitcher plants, a few sticky round sundew leaves and one large open violet-red bloom. A soft cloud of yellow-green pollen drifts from the bloom. In the background, a soft wash of sage and meadow green with murky olive patches.

Bogcrown.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single huge creature rests in a misty bog in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, seen from a slightly low angle, its full body filling most of the wide frame, half submerged in dark still water among reeds. Soft light comes from the upper left through drifting mist. The creature is a massive, ancient snapping turtle with a broad, ridged dark olive-brown shell, rough mossy-green skin with pale yellow spots, a heavy hooked beak and glowing orange eyes. Its shell carries a whole bog garden crowned by a ring of tall wine-red and lime-green pitcher plants around one enormous open bloom of deep violet-red petals, like a crown. Long roots trail from its shell into the water, and thick yellow-green clouds of spores drift from the great bloom. In the background, a rich wash of sage, olive and deep green, with murky violet patches in the mist.

Pollenpup.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single young creature sits in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, among a patch of wildflowers and clover with a soft shadow beneath it. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its fluffy coat, with a gentle golden rim light. The creature is a fluffy, long-legged maned-wolf pup with soft tawny-gold fur, darker legs, a short dark muzzle, large upright ears and bright amber eyes. Its coat is dusted with fine yellow pollen, a small sprig of white clover flowers is caught behind one ear, and a short fluffy crest of darker fur runs down its neck. A few grains of pollen float around its nose. In the background, a soft wash of sage and meadow green with pale cream and buttercup-yellow patches.

Honeymane.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature stands in a flowering meadow in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, head raised. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its mane, with a golden rim light along its back. The creature is a tall, elegant, long-legged maned wolf with a tawny-gold coat, dark slender legs, a dark muzzle, large upright ears and warm amber eyes. A thick flowing mane of honey-gold fur runs from its neck down its shoulders, threaded with small wildflowers in white, yellow and pink, and glistening with drops of golden honey. A few honeybees hover around its mane. In the background, a soft wash of sage and meadow green with patches of buttercup yellow and cream.

Briarhog.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature sits centred in the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on a small patch of short green grass with a soft shadow beneath it. Soft warm key light comes from the upper left and catches the tips of its spines, with a gentle rim light along its back edge. The creature is a round hedgehog-like animal half curled into a ball, with a pointed face, mossy brown fur on its face and belly, a small black nose and bright dark eyes. Instead of quills, its back is covered in woody bramble thorns: brown and grey twig-like spines of different lengths curving outward, with small green leaves growing between them and five small pink wild-rose blossoms with yellow centres scattered across the crown of its back. Two short front paws with tiny claws show beneath its chin. In the background, a soft wash of sage and meadow green with pale cream patches.

Fernwhisk.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small creature sits upright on a mossy stone in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its fur, with a gentle rim light on its tail. The creature is a small squirrel-like animal with soft olive-brown fur, a pale cream belly, tufted ears, bright black eyes and tiny front paws holding a seed. Instead of a bushy tail it has a large curling tail made of green fern fronds, unfurling at the tip like a fiddlehead and raised high behind it like a fan. A few small leaves and seeds swirl in a breeze around it. In the background, a soft wash of sage and meadow green with pale cream patches.

Thistlewick.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature stands on a sun-warmed rock in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, head raised. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its spines, with a bright rim light along its back. The creature is a small, stout, spiky lizard built like a thorny devil, with sandy olive-green skin patterned in bands of moss green and cream, a short blunt head and bright golden eyes. Its whole body is covered in conical thorny spines like thistle prickles, and along its back rises a crest of purple thistle flowers with spiky green bracts, the largest one on a knob behind its head. A few fluffy white thistle seeds drift in the air around it. In the background, a rich wash of sage, meadow green and soft violet, with bright light behind the lizard.

Sparkit.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single young creature stands alert on its hind legs in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, on dusty pale ground with a soft grey shadow beneath it. Soft warm key light from the upper left highlights its face and back, with a cool silver-white rim light on its far side. The creature is a slim, small stoat kit with a long body, short legs, slate-grey fur on its back, a pale butter-yellow throat and belly, small round ears, a short pointed snout with a pink nose and bright black eyes. Faint pale-gold zigzag markings run down its back. Its long tail ends in a black tip that crackles with tiny bright sparks and small arcs of pale yellow-white electricity. In the background, a wash of pale butter yellow on the left blending into soft storm grey on the right, with a few faint diagonal streaks.

Arcfang.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature bounds forward across the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, mid-leap with its long body stretched, its full body filling most of the wide frame, over dusty pale ground with a soft shadow beneath it. Soft warm key light from the upper left highlights its back, with a cool silver-white rim light along its belly. The creature is a lean, agile, long-bodied marten-like predator with dense slate-grey fur, a pale butter-yellow throat and chest, small rounded ears, sharp dark eyes and two long pointed white fangs showing at the sides of its mouth. Bold pale-gold zigzag markings like lightning bolts run along its back and flanks. Bright jagged arcs of yellow-white electricity crackle between its fangs and along its long, bushy, black-tipped tail. In the background, a wash of pale butter yellow blending into storm grey, with faint diagonal streaks like rain.

Fulgurex.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single majestic creature stands on a rocky ridge in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, seen from a slightly low angle, its full body filling most of the wide frame, head raised. Soft warm light comes from the upper left, and a cold white glow from the electricity around it lights its fur. The creature is a large, powerful, heavy-shouldered predator built like a huge wolverine, with thick storm-grey fur, a pale butter-yellow chest, a broad head with small rounded ears, fierce golden eyes and long white fangs. Broad pale-gold zigzag markings like forked lightning run down its back and legs, and the fur along its spine stands up in a crackling crest. Jagged forked bolts of bright yellow-white lightning leap from its crest and from the black tip of its long bushy tail into the sky. Its four legs end in strong dark claws. In the background, a dramatic wash of dark storm grey with pale butter-yellow light breaking through behind the creature and faint diagonal streaks of rain.

Buzzlet.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature hovers in mid-air in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the frame, above a few tufts of pale meadow flowers in the lower part of the image. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its fuzzy back, with a cool rim light on its wings. The creature is a plump, round bumblebee-like insect with dense fuzzy fur in bands of charcoal black and pale butter yellow, a round dark face with large dark compound eyes, two short curved antennae and six small dark legs tucked beneath it. Its two pairs of small translucent wings blur with motion, and tiny sparks of pale yellow-white electricity flicker at their tips. A faint glow of static outlines its fur. In the background, a wash of pale butter yellow on the left blending into soft storm grey on the right, with a few faint diagonal streaks.

Hivevolt.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single large creature hovers in mid-air in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the wide frame, with a soft shadow on the pale ground far below. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its fuzzy back, with a cool silver-white rim light along its wings. The creature is a large, robust bumblebee-like insect with a thick fuzzy charcoal-black thorax, a heavy abdomen banded in pale butter yellow and gleaming copper, a broad dark face with large compound eyes and two curved antennae. Exactly six short dark legs, three on each side of the thorax, hang tucked beneath it. Its two pairs of wide translucent wings are veined in a fine honeycomb pattern of hexagons that glow faintly gold. Bright jagged arcs of yellow-white electricity crackle between its wingtips, and a small cloud of tiny glowing sparks circles around it like a swarm. In the background, a wash of pale butter yellow blending into storm grey, with faint diagonal streaks.

Ohmlet.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small creature stands in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, beside the broken halves of a pale speckled eggshell on a patch of dusty pale ground with a soft shadow beneath it. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its fluffy down, with a cool silver-white rim light on its far side. The creature is a round, freshly hatched chick with fluffy grey-brown down streaked with darker brown, a pale butter-yellow belly, a short dark beak, bright black eyes and two sturdy grey legs with long toes. A small tuft of stiff feathers on its head curls like coiled copper wire, glinting metallic orange, and a few tiny sparks of pale yellow-white electricity jump between its curls. In the background, a wash of pale butter yellow on the left blending into soft storm grey on the right, with a few faint diagonal streaks.

Ohmrunner.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single bird sprints across the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, mid-stride with one long leg reaching forward, its full body filling most of the wide frame, over dusty pale ground, with a trail of small sparks and dust behind it. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its back, with a cool silver-white rim light along its tail. The creature is a lean, long-legged ground bird built like a roadrunner, with grey-brown plumage streaked with darker brown, a pale butter-yellow belly, a long straight dark beak and bright alert eyes. A tall crest of stiff feathers curls back from its head like coiled copper wire, glinting metallic orange, and its long tail is held out straight behind it. Jagged threads of yellow-white electricity crackle along its crest and tail feathers. Its two strong grey legs end in long toes. In the background, a wash of pale butter yellow on the left blending into soft storm grey on the right, with a few faint diagonal streaks.

Stormox.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature stands centred in the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on dusty pale ground with a soft grey shadow beneath it. Soft warm key light comes from the upper left, and a cool silver-white rim light runs along its back. The creature is a sturdy young yak-like calf with a shaggy slate-grey coat hanging in long locks over its legs and belly, a broad muzzle with a pale pink nose and calm dark eyes. Two wide horns curve outward and upward from its head, ivory at the base and polished copper at the tips. Thin, bright, jagged arcs of pale yellow-white electricity crackle between the two horn tips and spark around its brow, where a raised tuft of dark grey fur is shaped like a small storm cloud. Its four legs end in dark cloven hooves. In the background, a wash of pale butter yellow on the left blending into soft storm grey on the right, with a few faint diagonal streaks.

Zippet.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small creature leaps through the air across the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, above dusty pale ground with a small soft shadow beneath it. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its back, with a cool silver-white rim light along its ears. The creature is a tiny jerboa-like rodent with soft sandy pale-yellow fur, a white belly, very long hind legs, tiny front paws held against its chest, large round dark eyes and tall rounded ears. Its very long thin tail ends in a fluffy black-and-white tuft that glows and crackles with small sparks of pale yellow-white static, leaving a short zigzag trail of light behind it. In the background, a wash of pale butter yellow on the left blending into soft storm grey on the right, with a few faint diagonal streaks.

Flashfin.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single fish leaps out of a choppy grey sea in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, with a splash of white water beneath it. Soft warm light from the upper left glints on its scales, with a cool rim light along its belly. The creature is a sleek flying fish with a torpedo-shaped body, a dark slate-blue back, a shining silver belly and large round dark eyes. Its long wing-like pectoral fins are spread wide; they are translucent pale yellow with dark veins, and bright arcs of yellow-white electricity crackle along their edges. A short burst of white light flashes around its head. Its forked tail flicks spray behind it. In the background, a wash of pale butter yellow blending into storm grey, with faint diagonal streaks of rain.

Squallkite.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single bird of prey hovers in strong wind in the centre of the frame, seen from slightly below in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its wings spread wide and filling most of the wide frame, against a stormy grey sky. Soft light comes from the upper left, and bright forks of lightning behind it throw a white rim light around its wings. The creature is an elegant, sleek kite with pale grey plumage, a white face and underside, black shoulder patches, a short hooked dark beak and striking red eyes. Its long pointed wings have pale butter-yellow bands across the flight feathers and darker grey tips, and its forked tail is fanned wide. Thin bright arcs of yellow-white electricity crackle from its wingtips, and its talons are drawn up beneath it. Swirling streaks of wind and rain surround it. In the background, a dramatic wash of storm grey and slate, with pale butter-yellow light breaking through behind the bird.

Knollop.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small creature sits in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, half emerged from a small mound of loose brown earth with a soft shadow beneath it. Warm key light from the upper left lights the top of its back, with a warm rim light along its side. The creature is a round, stocky mole-like animal with velvety dark brown fur, a pointed pink snout, tiny dark eyes and two broad pink front paws with large digging claws. Its rounded back carries a little hump of packed earth like a tiny hill, dotted with small pebbles and a few tufts of short green grass. Crumbs of soil tumble from its back. In the background, a wash of warm terracotta and ochre with lighter streaks behind the creature.

Knollgrim.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single heavy creature stands in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on cracked dry earth with a dark shadow beneath it. Warm key light from the upper left lights the stony ridge of its back, with a warm rim light along its side. The creature is a big, hulking mole-like beast with coarse dark brown fur, a broad pointed snout with a pink nose, small fierce dark eyes and powerful pink front paws with huge curved digging claws. Its broad back rises into a craggy hill of packed earth and grey granite plates, broken into jagged points like a rocky crust, with a few tufts of dry grass between the stones. Small chips of stone crumble from its shoulders. In the background, a wash of warm terracotta and ochre with darker dusty patches toward the corners.

Knollossus.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single colossal creature stands in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, seen from a low angle so it towers over the viewer, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on cracked earth that splits beneath its claws. Warm key light from the upper left lights the rocky summit of its back, with dust glowing in the light. The creature is an enormous, ancient mole-like beast with coarse dark brown fur, a broad pointed snout with a pink nose, small deep-set dark eyes and massive pink front paws with huge curved digging claws. Its vast back rises into a whole small hill: layered slopes of earth, grey granite crags and great boulders, with patches of green grass and a few small shrubs growing on its peak. Pebbles and dust tumble from its sides as the ground trembles. In the background, a wash of warm terracotta and ochre with lighter streaks of dust in the air.

Shalepup.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single young creature stands in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, tail up and one front paw lifted, on rocky ground with scattered flat stones and a soft shadow beneath it. Warm key light from the upper left lights the stone plates on its back, with a warm rim light along its side. The creature is a sturdy puppy with short brown-grey fur, a broad head, floppy ears, a dark nose and bright dark eyes. Along its back and the top of its head lie a few flat, layered plates of grey-blue shale with thin pale stripes, overlapping like roof tiles. Its oversized paws end in dark claws. In the background, a wash of warm terracotta and ochre with lighter streaks behind the creature.

Shalehound.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature stands in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, alert and ready to run, on rocky ground strewn with flat stones and a soft shadow beneath it. Warm key light from the upper left lights the stone plates on its back, with a warm rim light along its legs. The creature is a lean, long-legged hound with short brown-grey fur, a long narrow muzzle, folded ears, a dark nose and keen amber eyes. Rows of flat, layered grey-blue shale plates with thin pale stripes run from its brow down its neck and back like overlapping tiles, and smaller plates cover its shoulders. Its long tail is held out straight behind it. In the background, a wash of warm terracotta and ochre with lighter streaks behind the creature.

Cragmastiff.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single massive creature stands on a rocky outcrop in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, seen from a slightly low angle, its full body filling most of the wide frame. Warm key light from the upper left lights the stone armour on its back, with dust glowing in the air. The creature is a huge, heavily built mastiff with a deep chest, short brown-grey fur, a massive broad head with heavy jowls, small folded ears, a dark nose and steady amber eyes. Its brow, neck, shoulders and back are armoured with thick, layered grey-blue shale and craggy granite plates with pale stripes, overlapping like the strata of a cliff and rising into jagged ridges along its spine. Its four thick legs end in heavy dark claws, and cracks spread in the rock beneath its front paws. In the background, a wash of warm terracotta and ochre with darker dusty patches toward the corners.

Brawlet.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single young creature stands squarely in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, front paws planted and chest puffed out defiantly, on dusty ochre ground with a soft shadow beneath it. Warm key light from the upper left lights its pale back, with a warm rim light along its side. The creature is a stocky young honey-badger-like animal with a broad pale silver-grey stripe of fur running from the top of its head down its back, jet-black legs, face and belly, small round ears, a short snout with a dark nose and fierce dark eyes. Its front paws are thick and strong, with long pale claws. A little dust puffs up around its paws. In the background, a wash of warm terracotta and ochre with lighter streaks behind the creature.

Ironbrawl.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single powerful creature rears up on its hind legs in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, front paws raised like fists, on dusty ochre ground with a dark shadow beneath it. Warm key light from the upper left glints on its metal plates, with a warm rim light along its back. The creature is a large, muscular honey-badger-like beast with a broad silver-grey stripe running from its head down its back, jet-black legs, face and belly, small scarred round ears, a short snout and fierce dark eyes. Its thick forearms and shoulders are covered in dark iron-grey plates with a dull metallic sheen, riveted together like gauntlets, and its long claws are iron-dark. Dust swirls around its feet. In the background, a wash of warm terracotta and ochre with darker dusty patches toward the corners.

Tusklet.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature charges across the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, mid-stride with its front legs reaching forward over sandy ground. Warm key light comes from the upper left, with a warm rim light along its back. The creature is a stocky wild boar piglet with a coarse bristly coat in russet brown marked with pale tan stripes running the length of its body, upright pointed ears, a long snout ending in a pink nose disc, and small dark eyes. Two short curved ivory tusks, one on each side, point upward from the corners of its mouth. All four legs end in small dark split hooves caked with mud. Puffs of tan dust and small pebbles kick up behind its hind legs. In the background, a wash of warm terracotta and ochre with lighter streaks behind the creature.

Gritfang.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature stands in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, head low and jaws slightly open, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on sandy ground with a soft shadow beneath it. Warm key light from the upper left lights its back and shoulders, with a warm rim light along its legs. The creature is a powerful hyena-like beast with sloping shoulders, a thick neck, coarse sandy-tan fur flecked with dark brown spots and grains of grit, a short bristly dark mane along its spine, rounded ears and a broad, heavy muzzle with strong white fangs. Its eyes are a sharp amber. Its four sturdy legs end in dark blunt claws, and a little sand trickles from its fur. In the background, a wash of warm terracotta and ochre with lighter streaks behind the creature.

Bouldergut.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single heavy creature sits in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, leaning back against a pile of rocks, on dusty ochre ground with a dark shadow beneath it. Warm key light from the upper left lights its rounded back, with a warm rim light along its side. The creature is a big, rotund wombat-like beast with short, thick grey-brown fur, a broad flat head with small round ears, a wide dark nose and small calm dark eyes. Its huge round belly is a smooth, polished grey boulder flecked with lighter speckles, and patches of stony texture show on its shoulders and back. Its short thick legs end in blunt dark claws. A few pebbles lie scattered around it. In the background, a wash of warm terracotta and ochre with lighter streaks behind the creature.

Slatebrow.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single large creature stands on a ledge of layered rock in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, seen from a slightly low angle, its full body filling most of the wide frame, head raised proudly. Warm key light from the upper left lights its heavy brow, with dust glowing in the air. The creature is a big, powerful, ground-dwelling lizard built like a rhinoceros iguana, with a thick tail, sturdy bowed legs, rough grey-brown scaly skin and keen golden eyes. Its massive head is crowned by a thick bony brow shield made of stacked dark slate plates, rising into three blunt horns above its snout. A ridge of flat slate spines runs down its neck and back. Its strong legs end in dark claws gripping the rock, and a few small stones tumble from the ledge. In the background, a rich wash of warm terracotta, ochre and deep rust, with bright golden light behind the creature.

Wispun.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small creature clings to a thin twig in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, with a soft violet mist drifting around it. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its fur, and a faint lilac glow from its eyes lights its face. The creature is a tiny sugar-glider-like animal with soft pale lilac-grey fur, a dark violet stripe running from between its eyes down its back, a pale cream belly, small rounded ears and very large round dark eyes with a soft lilac shine. Thin folds of skin between its front and hind legs are edged with fur that fades into wisps of pale violet mist. Its long fluffy tail curls beneath the twig. In the background, a wash of dusty lavender and violet, darker toward the upper corners.

Wispelle.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature glides through the air in the centre of the frame, seen from slightly below in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its limbs spread wide and its full body filling most of the wide frame, with soft violet mist trailing behind it. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its fur, and a faint lilac glow from its eyes lights its face. The creature is a graceful flying-squirrel-like animal with soft pale lilac-grey fur, a dark violet stripe running from its brow down its back, a pale cream belly, rounded ears and large dark eyes with a lilac shine. Wide gliding membranes stretch between its front and hind legs, and their edges dissolve into long ribbons of pale violet mist that stream behind it. Its long feathery tail trails like a plume of fog. In the background, a wash of dusty lavender and violet, darker toward the upper corners.

Wraithelle.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single majestic creature glides through a dark violet night sky in the centre of the frame, seen from slightly below and facing the viewer, its vast membranes spread wide and filling most of the wide frame. Soft cool light comes from the upper left, and a lilac glow from its eyes lights its face. The creature is a large, elegant colugo-like glider with soft pale lilac-grey fur, a dark violet stripe running from its brow down its back, a pale cream chest, a slender face and large deep violet eyes that glow softly. Enormous gliding membranes stretch from its neck to its fingertips and toes and on to the tip of its tail, translucent dusky violet like a ghostly cloak, their edges fraying into long drifting veils of mist. Small pale motes of light drift around it. In the background, a wash of deep violet and indigo with a lighter lavender haze behind the creature.

Hexlet.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small creature grips a thin curved branch in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its skin, with a faint lilac glow along its back. The creature is a small chameleon with deep violet skin patterned with pale lilac spirals and dots, a small rounded casque on its head, two bulging turret eyes that look in different directions and a long tail curled into a tight spiral. Its feet are clasped around the branch. One tiny glowing violet orb floats just above its head. In the background, a wash of dusty lavender and violet, darker toward the upper corners.

Hexmage.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature climbs along a twisted branch in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its skin, and the glowing orbs around it cast small lilac highlights on its body. The creature is a larger chameleon with deep violet skin patterned with pale lilac spirals and dots, a tall pointed casque on its head that sweeps back like a hood, two bulging turret eyes swivelled in different directions, a short horn on its snout and a long tail curled into a spiral. Its clasping feet grip the branch. A loose ring of small glowing violet orbs floats around its head. In the background, a wash of dusty lavender and violet, darker toward the upper corners.

Hexarch.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single majestic creature perches on a thick twisted branch in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, seen from a slightly low angle, its full body filling most of the wide frame. Soft light comes from the upper left, and a bright violet glow from the orbs around it lights its face. The creature is a large, regal chameleon with deep violet and indigo skin patterned with shimmering pale lilac spirals, a tall crowned casque on its head rising into three long horns, two bulging turret eyes swivelled in different directions and a long tail curled into a perfect spiral. A frilled crest runs down its back. Its clasping feet grip the branch. A wide ring of glowing violet orbs circles slowly around its head and shoulders, joined by faint threads of light. In the background, a rich wash of deep violet and indigo with a lighter lavender haze behind the creature.

Dozel.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small creature sits curled on a mossy log in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, eyes half closed as if about to fall asleep. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its fur. The creature is a plump, round dormouse-like animal with thick soft lavender-grey fur, a cream belly, small rounded ears, heavy-lidded sleepy dark eyes, long whiskers and tiny pink paws held against its chest. Its long, very bushy tail curls around its body like a blanket. A pale crescent-shaped marking sits on its forehead. A few small glowing motes drift lazily above its head. In the background, a wash of dusty lavender and violet, darker toward the upper corners.

Somnitar.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single large creature lies curled on a mossy hillock in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, head raised drowsily. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its fur, and a faint silver glow from the motes around it touches its face. The creature is a big, round, plush dormouse-like animal with thick soft lavender-grey fur speckled with tiny pale dots like stars, a cream belly, rounded ears, half-closed dreamy violet eyes and long whiskers. A glowing pale crescent marking shines on its forehead. Its huge bushy tail curls around it in a wide spiral, and small drifting motes of soft white and lilac light float around it like a slow halo. In the background, a wash of dusty lavender and deep violet, darker toward the upper corners.

Glimmox.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single small creature stands in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the frame, on a low patch of violet-tinted ground with a soft shadow beneath it. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its back, and a bright reflection gleams on its brow. The creature is a small, slender, delicate antelope-like calf with a soft lavender-grey coat, pale cream legs and belly, large dark gentle eyes, big rounded ears and thin legs with tiny dark hooves. Two short spiral horns of iridescent clear glass rise from its head, and between them a round, polished, mirror-like disc set into its brow reflects a soft lilac light. A few faint rings of light ripple outward from the disc. In the background, a wash of dusty lavender and violet, darker toward the upper corners.

Gloamowl.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature stands centred in the frame, turned slightly toward frame-left and facing the viewer, its full body filling most of the wide frame, on a low patch of violet-tinted ground with a soft shadow beneath it. Soft warm key light comes from the upper left, and a faint lilac glow from its eyes lights the feathers around its face. The creature is a small, round-bodied owl with short ear tufts, dusky violet and deep indigo plumage speckled with tiny pale dots like stars in a twilight sky, a short hooked grey beak and large round pale lilac eyes with dark pupils that glow faintly. Its folded wings show layered feather edges in lighter lavender, and its feathered feet grip the ground with grey talons. A loose halo of small drifting motes of soft white light floats around its head and shoulders. In the background, a wash of dusty lavender and violet, darker toward the upper corners.

Moonmoth.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single large moth rests with its wings spread on a pale stone in the centre of the frame, seen from slightly above and facing the viewer, its wings filling most of the wide frame, under a large faint full moon in the upper part of the sky. Soft silver light from the upper left shines through its wings. The creature is a large, elegant moth with a furry pale silver-lilac body and two broad feathery antennae. Its four wings are soft pearl white shading to lilac and dusky violet at the edges, each forewing marked with a glowing pale crescent-moon eyespot and each hind wing ending in a long curling tail. Fine silver dust drifts from its wings and glimmers in the air. In the background, a rich wash of deep violet and indigo with a pale silver glow around the moon and behind its wings.

Burrowbit.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single young creature sits up on its haunches in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, beside the dark opening of a small burrow in a grassy bank. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its fur, with a gentle rim light along its ears. The creature is a small wild rabbit kit with soft sandy grey-brown fur, a pale cream belly, a white cotton tail, large dark eyes, long ears with dark tips and a pale cream blaze running up its forehead. Its front paws are dusted with soil. A few blades of grass stick out of its mouth. In the background, a soft wash of neutral cream and pale warm grey with faint blotches of pigment.

Warrenbuck.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single creature stands alert on a grassy bank in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-left, its full body filling most of the wide frame, powerful hind legs braced as if about to bolt. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its back, with a gentle rim light along its ears. The creature is a strong, lean adult jackrabbit-like hare with sandy grey-brown fur, a pale cream belly, a white tail, alert dark eyes, very long upright ears with dark tips and a pale cream blaze running up its forehead. Its long muscular hind legs and large feet are planted in the grass. A little dust and a few blades of grass fly up behind it. In the background, a soft wash of neutral cream and pale warm grey with faint blotches of pigment.

Warrenking.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single majestic creature sits upright on top of a grassy mound in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, seen from a low angle, its large body filling most of the frame from the tips of its ears to the mound at the bottom edge. Soft warm light comes from the upper left and lays golden highlights on its ears and ruff. The creature is a large, regal hare with thick sandy grey-brown fur, a pale cream belly, a white tail, wise dark eyes, very tall upright ears with dark tips and a pale cream blaze on its forehead that widens into a crown-like shape. A great ruff of long pale cream fur sweeps around its neck and shoulders like a royal mantle. Its powerful hind legs are folded beneath it. Several burrow openings dot the mound below. In the background, a soft wash of neutral cream, pale gold and warm grey, lighter behind the hare.

Pecklet.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design. A single young bird stands in the centre of the frame in a three-quarter view facing frame-right, its full body filling most of the frame, on a flat stone at the edge of a calm pond with a few reeds. Soft warm key light from the upper left lights its fluffy down, with a gentle rim light along its back. The creature is a gangly heron chick with fluffy pale grey down, a spiky tuft of downy feathers sticking up on its head, a long pointed yellow beak, round bright yellow eyes and long thin yellow-green legs. Its small stubby wings are half raised. In the background, a soft wash of neutral cream and pale warm grey with faint horizontal strokes.

Galeheron.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as trading card art for an original creature design.
